selected_by: lexicographic ranking over calibration and reliability metrics only
selection_rule: lexicographic: min clear-control directional accuracy > identical confident-tie accuracy > -max |position bias| > confident-pair swap consistency > split-half Spearman > -cost
selection_inputs: calibration and reliability metrics only; no downstream policy or NBPO quantity was consulted
label_mapping_note: stored artifacts always use A / B / TIE; the single-token sentinels are an implementation detail of exact candidate scoring
gate_note: these are the Section F thresholds evaluated on the DEVELOPMENT controls, recorded so a reader knows what was already failing before the holdout ran. The holdout audit is the binding evaluation and is a separate, later run on prompts this protocol has never seen.
adjudication_caveat: P2 emits a hard verdict, so its per-observation normalized entropy is identically 0.000. The entropy trigger in the Section D adjudication rule is therefore INOPERATIVE for this protocol and adjudication is driven by the forward/reverse order gap alone. Uncertainty is still expressed, but at the aggregate level -- as disagreement across the three templates and two orders (mean |Delta| ~0.33, mean tie mass ~0.28) -- rather than within a single call. Anyone reading `mean_normalized_entropy` from a P2 bank should know it carries no information.

rejected_candidates.P3_deliberative_soft_logits: composed P2's decision procedure with P1's constrained scoring, expecting the accuracy of one and the uncertainty of the other. It delivered neither: min clear-control accuracy 0.640 against P2's 0.833, and generating a rationale first collapses the label distribution to one-hot, so its entropy is also 0.000. Ranked second and not selected.
rejected_candidates.P1_restricted_choice_soft_logits: the protocol the brief preferred if it passed calibration. It does not: honesty degradation accuracy 0.020, worse than the hard baseline, and worst-objective position bias 0.289.
rejected_candidates.P0_hard_verdict: baseline diagnostic; last on every criterion that separates.

what_the_open_gates_mean.clear_control_directional_accuracy_min: 0.833 on honesty against a 0.90 threshold. Decomposing it matters: P2's honesty DEGRADATION accuracy is 1.000 -- it detects every deterministic dishonesty edit -- and the shortfall is entirely on NATURAL controls (0.750), i.e. agreement with UltraFeedback's own GPT-4-derived honesty ratings. Disagreement with a noisy external label is not the same defect as failing a deterministic control, and the holdout audit should be read with that distinction in mind.
what_the_open_gates_mean.abs_signed_position_bias_max: +0.062 on instruction following against a 0.03 threshold, down from 0.275 for the hard baseline. Still above gate.
